disputes.reason: Relies on a non-standard convention: in standard usage the equity tranche attaches at 0% and the senior tranche detaches at 100%, so a candidate can reasonably say equity has both points and senior has both; the 'true' label is not safe.

Labelled false only because of the contested 'equity has no attachment point' convention; under the standard definition equity attaches at 0% and so has both points, so the claim is defensible and the false label is unsafe.

Contested: overcollateralization is a cushion that enhances the credit quality of the notes generally (the source's own original key was the whole portfolio and had to be corrected), so 'primarily the junior notes' is arguable either way and not safe as a clear true.
